description: This file contains functions for accessing and manipulating PHY registers over MDIO and OCP interfaces for the RTL8367C switch ASIC. It includes functions to read and write PHY registers, as well as Serdes registers, handling low-level register access protocols.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Sets the PHY OCP register at the specified address for a given port, handling register address construction and communication protocol.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Reads the PHY OCP register at the specified address for a given port, including busy status polling.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Wrapper function to set PHY register via OCP interface, calculating the OCP address based on PHY address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Wrapper function to get PHY register via OCP interface, calculating the OCP address based on PHY address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
methods.description: Sets a Serdes register on specific page and address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
methods.description: Gets a Serdes register value from specific page and address.
